name: std::stop_source::stop_possible
intro: Checks if the stop_source object has a stop-state.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the stop_source object has a stop-state, otherwise false.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the stop_source object has a stop-state and a stop request has already been made, this function still returns true.

summary: Checks if the stop_source object has a stop-state.

recommendedExamples.output:
stop_source stop_possible = true, stop_requested = false
  worker2 goes back to sleep
  worker3 goes back to sleep
  worker1 goes back to sleep
  worker4 goes back to sleep
Request stop
stop_source stop_possible = true, stop_requested = true
  worker3 is requested to stop
  worker1 is requested to stop
  worker2 is requested to stop
  worker4 is requested to stop
